gloss: permanent residency; right of permanent residence

definitions.gloss: permanent residency; right of permanent residence
definitions.explanation: The legal right to reside permanently in a country. In Japan, this refers to a specific visa status that allows foreign nationals to live and work in Japan indefinitely.

examples.japanese: {永住権|えいじゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
{永住権|えいじゅうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: Applying for permanent residency takes time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{暮|く}らして→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{永住権|えいじゅうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: After living in Japan for over ten years, I was finally granted permanent residency.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal legal term commonly encountered in immigration contexts. Relevant for foreign nationals living in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧ (to obtain permanent residency)
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧ (to apply for permanent residency)
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (to be granted permanent residency)
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}⟦{保持者|ほじしゃ}→保持者：28959_hojisha⟧ (permanent resident)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{在留資格|ざいりゅうしかく}→在留資格：18891_zairyuushikaku⟧ (residence status)
- ⟦{帰化|きか}→帰化：19840_kika⟧ (naturalization — becoming a citizen, distinct from permanent residency)
